In 2018 OpenAI described an approach to language understanding that combined two existing ideas, transformers and unsupervised pre-training.
In 2019 OpenAI created OpenAI LP, a capped-profit company meant to increase its investment in compute and talent while keeping its mission's checks and balances.

In 2023 Amazon and Anthropic announced a strategic collaboration in which Amazon would invest up to $4 billion and hold a minority stake in Anthropic.
In 2023 Anthropic published its Responsible Scaling Policy, a series of technical and organizational protocols for managing the risks of developing increasingly capable AI systems.

provisional_rows.title: AI

provisional_rows.milestone: Whether artificial intelligence should be built and deployed as fast as possible to capture its benefits, or slowed and controlled until its risks are better understood.
provisional_rows.stakes: The argument turns on whether machines that mimic human judgment can be trusted with decisions that affect jobs, safety, and truth itself.
